## Summary of Changes

Describe what this PR modifies, adds, or fixes.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New security documentation / guide
- [ ] New code example (`examples/`)
- [ ] Fix for code syntax or security recommendation
- [ ] Translation / regional compliance note
- [ ] CI / tooling improvement

## Standards Checklist

Please verify before submitting:
- [ ] Documentation follows the standard doc template (Quick Answer, Threat Model, Vulnerable Example, Secure Implementation, Checklist, Official Sources).
- [ ] PHP code adheres to PHP 8.4+ and PSR-12 / PER-CS 2.0.
- [ ] No deprecated or insecure functions (`md5`, `sha1`, `rand`, `X-XSS-Protection`).
- [ ] All code runs cleanly through `php -l` without syntax errors.
- [ ] All claims cite official documentation or verified standards (OWASP, NIST, official Laravel/PHP docs).
- [ ] No emojis in headings or code comments.
